entries.claim: Primary artifact is Grok Bot 0.24.0 linux x64 with SHA-256 8d14c2bcecafe2f4dac4a90d9842bd94642851ee60de778ca614bfb11af53177
Renderer↔main edge exposes exactly 145 RPC methods over dune-rpc channels with probe/envelope semantics
Preload exposes exactly two bindings: desktop and coordinatorPort
node-agent-coordinator declares 103 distinct commands across coordinator-main/control edges with typed reply kinds
Control protocol uses lifecycle|request|cancel|reply|event frames with welcome→hello handshake and numeric protocolVersion (=1 observed)

evidence.detail: frame switch + phase validators at multiple sites

entries.claim: Agent store is SQLite (better-sqlite3) with tables meta/files/pending_deletes/agents/messages/media/kv/blobs/transcript_entries
SandBox has run states ABSENT/HIBERNATED/RUNNING, 8-phase migration state machine, and an upgrade-schedule state machine
Renderer navigates via an in-app page stack (history.pages, View* models) rather than a URL router

evidence.detail: no router framework strings; history.pages stack present

entries.claim: Design tokens use --sand-* custom properties plus --cursor-radius-* scale
Feature flags/experiments are Statsig-based (featureassets.org/statsigapi.net endpoints, gate overrides env SAND_FEATURE_GATE_OVERRIDES)
App package name is 'sand' (productName 'Grok Bot'), built on @anysphere/* workspace stack

Auto-review approvals resolve via resolveAutoReviewApproval; local-tool permission via resolveLocalToolPermission + recordLocalToolApproval(approvalId, action, target); secrets via listSecrets/revealSecret/upsertSecrets/removeSecrets desktop commands and submitSecret/setBoxSecrets coordinator/host side

agent.v1.ControlService is the box-side execution contract: 26 methods covering exec streaming, filesystem read/write/list/diff, artifact persist/restore (agent store + parent store), env updates, skills/plugins reload + install, MCP server load and refresh-token retrieval, GitHub token refresh, remote-access warmup

Box lifecycle is a cloud-mediated surface: GrokBotService+SandBoxService expose ensure/recreate/forceRecreate, ServerStreaming watchSandBoxMigration, run-state and upgrade-schedule getters/schedulers, presigned store writes incl. multipart complete/abort, admin snapshot/manifest-version/restore/hibernate and team member sandbox kill

Automation memory is a first-class durable plane distinct from conversation transcripts and the agent store: AutomationsService (42 methods) includes listAutomationMemories/getAutomationMemory/updateAutomationMemory/deleteAutomationMemory plus spec validate/apply, workflow templates, run lifecycle and Sentry integration

A separate local-exec-daemon bundle (~4MB) runs exec outside the box path; its state is a set of JSON files (connection, discovery, credential, supervisor, update-lease, account-retire, account-generation, log) whose paths are joined by the coordinator; generation counters gate ownership handoff

evidence.detail: local-exec-daemon-connection.json .. local-exec-account-generation.json filename constants + join() usage

entries.claim: MCP server config syncs from app state onto the box filesystem under a single-writer lease with expected-vs-actual divergence telemetry; tool calls carry per-call failure_reason/retryable classification proving per-tool failure isolation at the telemetry boundary

Native payload = 9 N-API .node modules + 1 Windows helper. Linux-active set: better_sqlite3, tree-sitter, tree-sitter-bash, whichlang-node.linux-x64-gnu, tree-chunk-napi.linux-x64-gnu, cursor_proclist (napi_register_module_v1 verified via nm). Win32-only payloads (tree-chunk-napi.win32, whichlang.win32, tree-sitter-bash win32 prebuild, sand-webauthn-signer.exe) are quarantined as inert on this linux port

evidence.detail: nm -D exports: napi_register_module_v1 present in all active modules

entries.claim: Feature-gate vocabulary totals 212 distinct SAND_* names across shipped bundles (163 config knobs + 49 enum members), Statsig-backed with desktop override commands and SAND_FEATURE_GATE_OVERRIDES / SAND_MODEL_EXPERIMENT_OVERRIDE env overrides; bundled presence is capability evidence only

evidence.detail: per-bundle SAND_* extraction with provenance; featureassets.org/statsigapi.net endpoints
